title.zh: OpenAI 洽谈最高 300 亿美元融资，估值约 1.25 万亿美元
title.en: OpenAI in talks to raise up to $30B at roughly $1.25T valuation

current_state.zh: OpenAI 目前寻求以 1.25 万亿美元投前估值融资约 200 亿美元，较此前 300 亿美元目标下调；首轮交割预计低于 200 亿美元，背景是 AI 概念股抛售及 Anthropic 即将 IPO。
current_state.en: OpenAI now seeks about $20B at a $1.25T pre-money valuation, down from the prior $30B target; the first close is expected below $20B amid an AI stock selloff and Anthropic's upcoming IPO.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI计划以1.4万亿美元估值融资300亿美元
updates.title_en: OpenAI计划以1.4万亿美元估值融资300亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh:
据 BlockBeats 援引彭博社 9 月 30 日的报道，OpenAI 计划以 1.4 万亿美元估值融资 300 亿美元。该报道描述的是一项融资计划，并未表明交易已经完成。

若按此规模完成，这将是史上规模最大的私募融资之一，所募资金将直接投入 OpenAI 的算力建设，并影响其与其他前沿 AI 实验室的竞争格局。

该数字来源于彭博社，时间标注为 9 月 30 日；报道所描述的核心要素是融资金额、估值，以及该融资目前仍属计划、而非已完成交易这一事实。

updates.market_impact_zh: OpenAI 的股权并不在加密市场直接交易，因此其影响主要通过情绪与资金流向传导至 AI 叙事相关资产，例如去中心化算力与 AI Agent 类代币；同时，如此规模的私募融资也会影响整体私募市场的流动性环境，进而关系到加密与 AI 创业项目可获得的冒险资本规模。

updates.title_zh: OpenAI接近完成新一轮融资，寻求以1.25万亿美元投前估值筹集最多300亿美元资金
updates.title_en: OpenAI Nears Close of New Funding Round, Seeking Up to $30 Billion at a $1.25 Trillion Pre-Money Valuation
updates.what_changed_zh: 据 CNBC 报道，OpenAI 正接近完成同一轮融资，寻求以 1.25 万亿美元投前估值筹集最多 300 亿美元，阿联酋投资者与 Coatue 共同领投，并计划在下周结束前签署协议；最终融资规模仍未确定，公司将其定位为潜在 IPO 前的“机会型过桥融资”。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI is reportedly nearing the close of the same funding round, seeking up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation, with UAE investors and Coatue co-leading and agreements targeted by the end of next week; the final size is still being determined, and the raise is positioned as opportunistic bridge financing ahead of a possible IPO.
updates.current_state_zh: OpenAI 正接近完成一轮最多 300 亿美元的融资，最新报道的投前估值为 1.25 万亿美元，阿联酋投资者与 Coatue 共同领投，目标在下周结束前签署协议；交易尚未完成，最终规模仍待确定，并被定位为潜在 IPO 前的过桥融资。
updates.current_state_en: OpenAI is nearing the close of a funding round of up to $30 billion, with the latest report citing a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation, co-led by UAE investors and Coatue, and agreements targeted by the end of next week; the deal is not yet signed, the final size remains undetermined, and it is positioned as bridge financing ahead of a possible IPO.
updates.detailed_summary_zh:
据 CNBC 报道，OpenAI 正接近完成新一轮融资，寻求以 1.25 万亿美元投前估值筹集最多 300 亿美元资金，来自阿联酋的投资者与投资机构 Coatue 共同领投。知情人士称，OpenAI 于周四向投资者表示计划在下周结束前完成协议签署，但本轮融资的最终规模仍在确定之中。

若本轮融资使 OpenAI 的估值突破 1 万亿美元，其将成为有史以来估值最高的私营公司。公司将此次融资定位为潜在 IPO 前的一笔「机会型过桥融资」。

1.25 万亿美元为投前估值，即不包含本轮新筹集的资金。OpenAI 同时还在就一项商业协议进行谈判，计划从阿联酋获得更多算力资源；首席财务官萨拉·弗莱尔此前已向员工表示，公司可能于 2027 年上市。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
OpenAI is nearing the close of a new funding round in which it is seeking to raise up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation, with investors from the UAE co-leading alongside investment firm Coatue, according to CNBC-sourced reports. OpenAI told investors on Thursday that it aims to sign the agreements by the end of next week, though the final size of the round is still being determined.

Should the round price OpenAI above a $1 trillion valuation, it would become the most highly valued private company on record. The company is positioning the raise as an "opportunistic bridge financing" ahead of a possible initial public offering.

The $1.25 trillion figure is a pre-money valuation, meaning it excludes the new capital being raised. OpenAI also is negotiating a commercial agreement to obtain additional computing resources from the UAE, and CFO Sarah Friar has previously told employees the company could list in 2027.
updates.background_zh: Coatue 是一家总部位于纽约、聚焦科技领域的投资管理公司，成立于 1999 年，由 Philippe Laffont 领导，同时投资公开市场与私募市场。过桥融资是一种过渡性资金，用于帮助公司在两次重大融资或关键节点之间衔接。
updates.background_en: Coatue is a New York-based, technology-focused investment management firm founded in 1999 and led by Philippe Laffont, investing across both public and private markets. A bridge round is interim financing meant to carry a company from one major financing or milestone to the next.
updates.market_impact_zh: OpenAI 本身没有直接的加密资产敞口，因此传导主要经由情绪层面：AI 与算力主题的加密代币交易者会把这类大规模 AI 融资和海湾主权资本的动向视为叙事热度的参考，而非直接驱动因素。
updates.market_impact_en: OpenAI has no direct crypto exposure, so any transmission runs through sentiment: large AI capital-formation and Gulf sovereign capital flows are watched by traders in AI- and compute-themed crypto tokens as a gauge of narrative momentum rather than as a direct driver.

updates.title_en: OpenAI融资目标骤降100亿美元，估值同步下调至1.25万亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenAI 将最新一轮融资目标规模从 300 亿美元下调 100 亿美元至约 200 亿美元，并将估值预期从 1.4 万亿美元下调至 1.25 万亿美元；知情人士称首轮交割预计低于 200 亿美元，因部分投资者下调认购额度。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI lowered its latest funding round target by $10B from $30B to about $20B and its valuation expectation from $1.4T to $1.25T; sources said the first close is expected below $20B as some investors reduced commitments.
updates.current_state_zh: OpenAI 目前寻求以 1.25 万亿美元投前估值融资约 200 亿美元，较此前 300 亿美元目标下调；首轮交割预计低于 200 亿美元，背景是 AI 概念股抛售及 Anthropic 即将 IPO。
updates.current_state_en: OpenAI now seeks about $20B at a $1.25T pre-money valuation, down from the prior $30B target; the first close is expected below $20B amid an AI stock selloff and Anthropic's upcoming IPO.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: OpenAI lowered its latest funding round target by $10B to about $20B and its valuation from $1.4T to $1.25T, with the first close expected to fall short as investors trim commitments amid a broad AI stock selloff.
updates.detailed_summary_en: OpenAI lowered its latest funding round target by $10B to about $20B and its valuation from $1.4T to $1.25T, with the first close expected to fall short as investors trim commitments amid a broad AI stock selloff.
updates.background_zh: OpenAI 最初计划以 1.4 万亿美元估值融资 300 亿美元，并将该轮融资定位为 IPO 前的入场机会。此次下调预期之前，科技股与 AI 概念股遭遇猛烈抛售；Business Insider 报道称，纳斯达克 100 指数曾在五个交易日内下跌逾 5%，为 4 月关税引发的抛售以来最差单周表现。《金融时报》还提到，最大竞争对手 Anthropic 即将上市也是拖累这轮融资的因素之一。
updates.background_en: OpenAI had originally planned to raise $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation in a round it positioned as a pre-IPO entry point. The revision follows a sharp selloff in technology and AI-related equities; Business Insider reported the Nasdaq 100 fell more than 5% over five days in one recent stretch, its worst weekly performance since the April tariff-driven selloff. The FT also cited the impending listing of rival Anthropic as a factor weighing on the round.
updates.market_impact_zh: OpenAI 私募估值基准下移，主要通过情绪渠道传导至 AI 相关加密资产——包括 AI 概念代币与加密相关的 AI 股票——考验投资者为 AI 敞口支付的溢价。这轮私募融资与加密市场之间不存在直接的托管、流动性或供给层面的联系。
updates.market_impact_en: A lower private-market valuation benchmark for OpenAI feeds mainly through sentiment into AI-adjacent crypto assets — AI-themed tokens and crypto-linked AI equities — by testing the premium investors assign to AI exposure. There is no direct custody, liquidity or supply link between this private fundraising and crypto markets.
